unmapped_findings: Lattice parameter of the 0Cu steel (Fe-28Mn-10Al-1C) under solution treatment is a = 0.3687 nm according to XRD calculations, compared with a = 0.3689 nm for the 3Cu steel.

The critical lattice parameter of the austenitic matrix for intragranular κ-carbide precipitation in Fe-Mn-Al-C steel is about a = 0.3670 nm; the 0Cu steel value (a = 0.3687 nm) is higher, so κ-carbide can precipitate from the 0Cu steel.

Using the composition boundary formula 0.208(wt.%C) + 0.098(wt.%Al) = 1 − 0.0054(wt.%Mn), the critical Al content for κ-carbide precipitation in the 0Cu steel is calculated to be 6.52 wt%; the Al content in the 0Cu steel exceeds 6.52 wt%, so κ-carbide has sufficient precipitation ability in this steel.
